about: Hand-written pairs for the final check of the own-model work, written on 2026-10-14 before the last round of training-data changes and not looked at (not even evaluated) until the final model was trained. Premise = a headline or reference sentence, hypothesis = a neutral claim; label = what a careful reader would say about the claim given only the premise. Subjects are institutions, fictional people or events from the public record; the topics deliberately differ from backend/eval/suites.
